text:
Nora B.: Proposal: 3-email "Spark" nudge for new newsletter signups who didn't click the welcome link. Goal = move to product blog + collect webinar interest. Window: 10 days.

Sam W.: Sounds good. Segments: Interested (clicked docs), Passive (opened only), Cold (no opens). Tailor first sentence per seg.

Ivy K.: Subjects to test:
- A: 'Welcome — quick tips + 10-min read'
- B: 'Redwood picks: what engineers are building'
We'll A/B by Passive and Cold; Interested gets A only.

Nora B.: Cadence:
T+0: short welcome + 1 blog CTA
T+4: proof point (benchmark blurb) + webinar interest CTA
T+10: gentle nudge + survey 1 question (what's blocking you?)

Samira (mail-bot): I'll append utm_source=newsletter, utm_campaign=spark_nudge_2823, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. Add suppress_on=clicked_welcome.

Sam W.: Deliverability: throttle 2500/hr, include List-Unsubscribe, run seed test. If open rate <10% for Cold after email 1, pause and rework subject.

Ivy K.: Creative small asks: use the same hero across segments, tweak one-liner. Add inline code snippet showing a simple API call as social proof. Keep it one-liner.

Nora B.: Landing: blog + webinar interest capture form (one checkbox). If they check, trigger follow-up invite and suppress remaining nudge.

Samira (mail-bot): Draft saved as spark_nudge_2823. Preflight scheduled 12h before send. :robot_face:

Nora B.: ETA: assets by EOD today, target send next Monday 9am PT. Thanks — will post final checklist when assets are up. :thumbsup:
